days.title: Volcanic Peaks and Lava Fields
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bláhnjúkur
stops.detail: The volcano Bláhnjúkur consists of gray-blue pitchstone.

stops.name: Brennisteinsalda
stops.detail: Reddish-brown slopes (rhyolite rock or quartz trachyte) can be found at the volcano Brennisteinsalda, which also show gray, bluish and white colorations in places due to sulfur and lime precipitates.

stops.name: Laugahraun
stops.detail: A shiny black obsidian lava field, the Laugahraun, extends from the solfataras at Brennisteinsalda to the river where a hut of the Icelandic Hiking Association stands and where one can bathe in a steaming stream.

days.title: Lakes, Craters and Long Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Frostastaðavatn
stops.detail: Near Landmannalaugar lies the charming lake Frostastaðavatn, to which one can hike on marked trails.

stops.name: Ljótipollur
stops.detail: Other paths lead from there for example to Landmannahellir or to the crater Ljótipollur.

stops.name: Laugavegur
stops.detail: Famous is the Laugavegur trekking trail, which leads from here via Þórsmörk further to Skógar on the coast.

days.title: Gorges and Mountain Ridges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Grænagil
stops.detail: A marked, relatively easy-to-walk circular path leads along its foot through the Grænagil gorge, onto the Laugahraun lava field and past the fumaroles and mud pots at the Brennisteinsalda volcano via the Laugavegur back to Landmannalaugar.

stops.name: Litla Brandsgil
stops.detail: A more demanding circular hike leads from the hut in Landmannalaugar, via the Litla Brandsgil gorge, the Skalli mountain and past Brennisteinsalda back to Landmannalaugar.
